subject: Security onboarding: SOC 2, pen-report request, and proposed scanning cadence
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Julia Morrison <julia.morrison@novahealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security onboarding: SOC 2, pen-report request, and proposed scanning cadence

Hi Julia —

Thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep your security team moving: 

1) SOC 2 evidence: we can share our SOC 2 Type II summary and the auditor letter. Grace, can you attach the high-level summary (not the full report) for initial review?

2) Vendor questionnaire: I heard you want to kick off the standard vendor security questionnaire (NOVA template). I attached our short vendor questionnaire (DOCX) for you to pre-fill; if you prefer, we can complete a Nova-specific questionnaire instead — just confirm format.

3) Penetration test / vulnerability sharing: you asked about our most recent external assessment. We can provide a redacted summary of the pen test findings plus our vulnerability triage and SLA table. For anything sensitive we can share under an NDA/BAA — happy to route a DocuSign link.

4) Proposed scanning cadence & remediation SLAs (suggestion):
   - External pen test: annual, shared redacted report within 5 business days of request (or under NDA for details)
   - Authenticated internal/ASV scans: monthly automated scans, quarterly full scope scans
   - Critical vuln SLA: 72 hours to acknowledge, 30 days to remediate or present compensating controls
   - High: 7 days to triage, 60 days to remediate; Medium/Low: tracked in backlog with 90/120 day targets

Next steps:
- Julia: please confirm whether Nova requires the full report under NDA or a redacted summary for initial legal/procurement review.
- If you want us to fill your questionnaire, attach it and we'll get it back in 2 business days.

Attaching: redwood_soc2_summary_2026Q1.pdf (summary), vendor-questionnaire-redwood.docx (blank).

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

---

From: Julia Morrison <julia.morrison@novahealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurements Team <procurements@novahealth.com>, security@novahealth.com
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security onboarding: SOC 2, pen-report request, and proposed scanning cadence

Sergio —

Appreciate the detailed recap. A few clarifications from the Nova side:

- Nova handles PHI for certain customers, so HIPAA controls and BAA are mandatory before any production integration. Will Redwood sign a standard BAA? If so, please point me to your legal contact or a prepared statement.

- For the pen test, procurement needs a redacted summary first but security@novahealth will request the full findings under NDA if there are any items marked Critical. Please send the redacted report; we will respond with whether an NDA is required.

- Questionnaire: we attached Nova's vendor security questionnaire in our last procurement email (I'll forward it separately). Please have your team fill sections 1–7 (infosec controls, encryption, logging, incident response) and return within 3 business days if possible.

- On remediation SLAs: Nova's bar for Critical is 14 days for remediation or documented compensating controls. Is Redwood able to commit to that?

I'll get procurement involved if we move to contract stage. Please also share a point of contact for your compliance/infosec owner to coordinate.

Thanks,
Julia Morrison
Director, Vendor Security
Nova Health

---

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Julia Morrison <julia.morrison@novahealth.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security onboarding: SOC 2, pen-report request, and proposed scanning cadence

Hi Julia —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the context on HIPAA/BAA. A few concrete items from our side: 

1) BAA & legal: Laura is on copy (our security & legal liaison). Laura, do you want me to route the standard Redwood BAA template to Julia and Procurements, or should we wait for your review?

2) SOC 2 / pen test materials: For initial procurement review I'm attaching the SOC 2 summary (redwood_soc2_summary_2026Q1.pdf). We can provide a redacted pen test summary now; the full technical report requires an NDA/BAA. I attached a one-page pen-test-request-form (pen-test-request-form.pdf) that outlines what we can share and the redaction policy.

3) SLAs — alignment proposal:
   - Critical: acknowledge within 24 hours, temporary mitigation/compensating control discussion within 72 hours, full remediation plan within 14 days, remediation tracked to completion within 30 days.
   - High: acknowledge 48 hours, remediation plan 14 days, remediation 60 days.
   - Medium/Low: acknowledge 5 business days, remediation tracked in backlog (90–120 days).

Our recommended cadence: authenticated scans weekly (internal), external ASV monthly, full scope vulnerability scan quarterly, and annual third-party pen test. We also run continuous dependency/SCA scans. The 30-day critical remediation target is our internal target; we appreciate if Nova prefers a 14-day hard SLA — Laura, can you advise feasibility from a product/security operations perspective?

4) Vendor questionnaire: we will fill Nova's vendor questionnaire if you forward it. Alternatively, you can complete our vendor-questionnaire-redwood.docx and we'll validate answers.

Next steps: 
- Julia: forward Nova questionnaire to this thread or confirm you want us to fill it.
- Laura: please confirm whether Redwood can accept a 14-day remediation punitive SLA for Critical issues in vendor terms, or propose alternate language.

Thanks — attaching SOC2 summary and pen-test-request-form for your intake.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Trust & Safety (Operations)
grace.oconnor@redwood.com

---

From: Julia Morrison <julia.morrison@novahealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurements Team <procurements@novahealth.com>, security@novahealth.com
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security onboarding: SOC 2, pen-report request, and proposed scanning cadence

Grace / Sergio —

Thanks — procurement pasted Nova's questionnaire into a shared Drive folder and I just uploaded a copy to the link below. We'll start with a redacted pen-test summary for intake. Procurement says they will require a signed BAA before we request the full report; I've looped Procurements on the CC so they can draft the official request.

We can accept Redwood's remediation commitments as long as they are reflected in the contract language (Procurements will draft the clause). For critical items: Nova still prefers a 14-day remediation expectation; if Redwood needs to push to 30 days for certain infrastructure items, we expect a documented compensating control and a joint remediation plan.

Action items I will take: 
- Procurements will send a DocuSign BAA request to Redwood (expect within 48 hours).
- Security (security@novahealth.com) will review the redacted pen summary; if any critical items are present they'll request the full report under NDA.
- I'll reply with any follow-up questionnaire items by EOD Tue.

Shared questionnaire: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1nova-qa-redwood-onboarding

Looking forward to closing this quickly.

Julia Morrison
Director, Vendor Security
Nova Health
